title: Kusanagi Nene — Messenger Of Feelings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu really just left.
I wonder if she's okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sorry about my brothers, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Just a little fight! Don't worry! We've made up already too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: With her gone, we can't actually do any talking.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I suppose we should call it a day as well then...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, excuse me. I think I left something at the Wonder Stage...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, would you mind going ahead without me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Uh, sure...? I'll be fine by myself.
Bye.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good evening. Are you on your way home from PXL?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I am. Is that your guitar case, Hoshino? So that means...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm heading home too. We rented a studio for our practice today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, excuse me if I'm mistaken but...
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If... If you don't mind, would you like to sit down and talk at the park?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, I'm not trying to force you into talking or anything but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If it's alright with you, I thought I'd lend you an ear so that you might feel a little better.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She seems so worried. Maybe I should tell her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, but... She goes to the same school as Emu...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I don't want her to worry about Emu either, so maybe I can tell her in a way that it's not obvious who I'm talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... There's just something I heard about this girl I know...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's always being obnoxious to her friends, but usually has a lot of energy and a smile on her face...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But lately, she's been preoccupied with something having to do with her family...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And her friends feel like they're not really in a position to say anything or butt into their business...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In the end, I... They just haven't been able to help her at all...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This girl means a lot to... Your friend.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Conversely, you may want to think about what exactly you want to do instead of how she feels...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? What I want to do?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Um, this is about... Someone I know too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This person has these friends they've known since they were little and were very close until middle school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But around their second year, one of these friends started to feel really down or depressed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So this person asked their friend if something was wrong, but they were just told it was nothing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They were so worried about their friend, but weren't really able to muster up the courage to do much in the end.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And they felt so sorry, so much regret over letting their friend go through that on their own... A lot of regret...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi... I understand why someone in that position would hesitate the way they are...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But if you do nothing while they remain lost... Who might feel the worst in the end?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She always says or does weird stuff, and gets everyone mixed into her antics...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I've enjoyed every minute of it so far...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I want Emu to keep doing outrageous things with Tsukasa. I want her to keep concocting crazy ideas with Rui. And...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I want her to laugh and smile like always...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm not sure what I should be doing right now, but I think I have an idea...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hoshino, thank you for listening. And for telling me about your friend too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope you'll be able to help your friend.
